title: A1
html: Choose a procedure for each situation, and say what family its guarantee refers to: (a) a trial with three doses and a placebo, where the protocol specifies the three comparisons with placebo; (b) eight fertilizers compared in a balanced field trial, with interest in every pair; (c) 5000 genes screened for association with a trait, to select candidates for a second study; (d) a contrast suggested by a plot of the group means.
